steps.name: implement
steps.description: Implement the task’s requested behavior, including relevant integration changes and tests. Infer the necessary files when file lists are absent; honor explicit exclusions. Choose a suitable plan and diagnose validation failures before retrying. Do not automatically split a task merely because it touches several files. Report what changed, validation results and any genuine blockers. Review staged and unstaged changes for unrelated edits and secrets before completing this step. Leave merges and pushes to Orchestra.

steps.name: review
steps.description: Review the task branch and any relevant uncommitted changes against the actual target/base. Check the requested behavior, acceptance criteria, regression risks, test evidence and data/security boundaries. Do not modify implementation files. Report specific findings with file locations and useful evidence; if changes are needed, post a blocker and release the step for rework. Approve only when the requested behavior is implemented and relevant validation is satisfactory.

steps.name: dream
steps.description: Analyze the completed work for worthwhile follow-ups. Report actionable improvements or observations with evidence, avoiding duplicates and arbitrary suggestion quotas. Create follow-up tasks only when warranted, linked to the parent/work item with useful acceptance criteria. Do not modify implementation code.
